content.text: VIN, usual type – combo VIN2 & VIN3
occurs most often in condyloma accuminata
▪︎Little evidence that this is a cancer precursor
▪︎60% of women with VIN3 also have cervical
itching, chronic irritation, raised mass lesion
isolated, and raised above the normal
epithelial surface with slightly rough texture
Lesions can be white and hyperkeratotic, or
VIN that is a superficial lesion of the epithelium that
(pre-cancer) – may progress to carcinoma in situ or squamous cell carcinoma
well-demarcated, slightly raised, erythematous lesion w/ an eczematoid appearance (scale)
*lesion that does not resolve within 6wks of
fiery red background mottled with whitish hyperkeratotic areas
large, pale cells of apocrine origin below the surface of the epithelium
: local wide excision or simple vulvectomy
red or white ulcerative or raised crusted lesion (ulcer, plaque, or mass)
: colposcopy w/ BX (acetic acid or toluidine blue application may aid BX)
